llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed HubSpot connector helper, but users should be careful with its optional CLI installer and HubSpot write actions.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to operate HubSpot through OOMOL's oo CLI, and the artifact only describes HubSpot connector actions for reading, creating, and updating contacts, companies, deals, and properties.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill routes HubSpot requests through Bash(oo *) and tells the agent to inspect live schemas before execution; it also explicitly requires user confirmation before write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The first-time setup section includes pipe-to-shell installer commands for the oo CLI, but they are disclosed, optional, and only suggested when oo is missing rather than hidden or automatic.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Networked access to OOMOL and HubSpot is proportionate to a HubSpot automation skill, and credentials are described as handled server-side by OOMOL rather than raw local tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on a user-installed CLI, OOMOL sign-in, and a connected HubSpot account, but it does not add background persistence, broad filesystem access, or unrelated privilege requests.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust OOMOL and intend to let the skill read and update the connected HubSpot account. Prefer reviewing the official oo CLI install guide or installer script before running it, and confirm exact payloads before any create or update action changes HubSpot data.
llm.findings: [SC2] expected: The reported curl-to-shell command is present in SKILL.md as an optional first-time oo CLI installation step. It is a real supply-chain risk pattern, but the artifact does not run it automatically and the behavior is coherent with a CLI-based HubSpot connector skill.
